minecraft-shape-calculator/features/accu: Pixel-perfect block layout using Minecraft's rounding rules
minecraft-shape-calculator/features/coor: Hover any cell to read its coordinates and follow the center guide lines when building
minecraft-shape-calculator/features/prev: Zoomable SVG preview with drag-to-pan to inspect every block up close
minecraft-shape-calculator/features/priv: All calculations run locally in your browser - nothing is uploaded
minecraft-shape-calculator/how_to_use/st: Pick a shape: a circle or a rounded rectangle.
Set the size (diameter, or width, height and corner radius), choose solid or hollow mode, and adjust the ring thickness for hollow shapes.
Click Calculate to see the total number of blocks and how many groups (64 blocks each) you need.
Inspect the preview: zoom in and drag to look around, hover a cell to see its coordinates, and follow the center guide lines when placing blocks.
minecraft-shape-calculator/message/radiu: The corner radius must be at most half of the smaller side.
minecraft-shape-calculator/message/thick: The outline thickness must be a whole number no larger than half of the size.
minecraft-shape-calculator/message/too_s: Diameter, width and height must be at least 3 blocks.
minecraft-shape-calculator/note: Calculate the blocks and groups you need to build circles and rounded rectangles in Minecraft, with a zoomable grid preview and cell coordinates.
minecraft-shape-calculator/result/empty: Enter the shape parameters and click Calculate.
